scripts.dev:
./install-nmh.sh && echo '
✅ Installation complete!

Manual step required:
1. Open Chrome
2. Go to chrome://extensions/
3. Enable Developer mode
4. Click "Load unpacked"
5. Select: '$(pwd)/extension/public'

The extension will show ID: snnfbcrozohafhbl (stable)
'
scripts.build: cd server && cargo build --release && cd ../extension && npm install && npm run build
scripts.clean: cd server && cargo clean && cd ../extension && npm run clean && ./uninstall-nmh.sh
